summary: An ExportMenu exporting three domain rows with custom column headers and a status line reporting the last export.
use: Table toolbars that let users download the current data set as a file in a chosen format.
spec: `data={rows}` with `const rows` of 3 objects with `domain`, `price` and `available` fields
`onexport` sets `last` to the exported `e.filename` and `e.rows` count
Idle status text is `Pick a format to download.`
